 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    uniform_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    uniform_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    line_colors = [grid[r][0] for r in uniform_rows] + [grid[0][c] for c in uniform_cols]
    divider = max(set(line_colors), key=line_colors.count)
    rows = [r for r in uniform_rows if grid[r][0] == divider]
    cols = [c for c in uniform_cols if grid[0][c] == divider]
    rb, cb = [-1] + rows + [h], [-1] + cols + [w]
    output = []
    for ri in range(len(rb)-1):
        outrow = []
        for ci in range(len(cb)-1):
            r0,r1,c0,c1=rb[ri]+1,rb[ri+1],cb[ci]+1,cb[ci+1]
            vals=[grid[r][c] for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)]
            background=max(set(vals),key=vals.count)
            markers=sum(v != background for v in vals)
            outrow.append(1 if markers > 1 else background)
        output.append(outrow)
    return output
"
